EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in History at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Future Sun Devil,
Thank you for expressing interest in the History (BA) (https://newcollege.asu.edu/history-studies-degree)program at Arizona State University. The course work covers a broad span of history from the ancient world to the modern period, and extends from Europe to Latin America and the United States. In addition to learning about the origins and development of various peoples, ideas and institutions of the past, students engage in the practice of history by learning to conduct original research, analyze historical evidence and formulate arguments using historiographical perspectives and methodological approaches. Students usually look to work as Archivists, Curators, Regulatory Affairs Managers, Editors, History teachers, and Historians among many others. By viewing the major map (https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/ASHISBA/null/ALL/2016), you can see the degree requirements outlined for graduation.
Be sure to review our admission and application requirements (https://students.asu.edu/freshman/requirements) for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format. For finding more ways to pay for college, please visit our scholarships page (https://newcollege.asu.edu/college-scholarships).
It's important to find the right fit for your undergraduate program. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can visit ASU and register for a tour (https://visit.asu.edu/). We can’t wait to see you here at West campus! If you have any questions about New College, West campus, or one of our 35 programs, please contact our Recruitment Office through the information listed below. Thank you, and we’ll talk to you soon!
Kindest Regards,
New College Recruitment Team New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus asknewcollege@asu.edu 602-543-2890 {!Case.Thread_}
